messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Morris <claire.morris@brightlinehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Steering committee readout + procurement path for Redwood pilot

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get the steering committee and procurement path aligned: 

What we learned (very high-level)
- Primary use: automated triage of patient intake notes + clinician summarization for care teams.
- Key non-negotiables: data residency controls, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence.
- Decision makers: Claire (clinical/exec sponsor), Tom (VP IT/tech evaluation), procurement team (T&Cs), and a steering committee of 4-5 clinical leaders for scope and success criteria.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Steering committee meeting: propose 45 minutes next week for an executive readout and to capture success criteria. I can present a 10-min pilot plan + 10-min security checklist review.
2) Procurement: can Claire introduce the procurement contact or confirm procurement@brightlinehealth is the right inbox? We’ll prepare a short SOW + T&Cs redline-ready doc.
3) Shared artifacts: attached draft agenda and my discovery notes. I’ll also send a lightweight SOW that we can iterate on.

Proposed times for steering committee (PST): Tue 6/16 10:00–10:45, Wed 6/17 9:00–9:45, Thu 6/18 1:00–1:45. If you prefer, I can send a 3-option Calendly.

Attachments: [Attachment: BRH-Steering-Agenda.pdf (PDF, 98KB)], [Attachment: Connor-Discovery-Notes.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)]

Thanks — talk soon.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Claire Morris <claire.morris@brightlinehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Steering committee readout + procurement path for Redwood pilot

Thanks Connor — good summary. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Steering committee: confirmed members are myself, Dr. Elena Park (Chief Medical Officer), Pilar Gomez (Director of Clinical Ops), and Marcus Reed (Director, Care Coordination). They want to see measurable success criteria (reduction in manual triage time, accuracy targets, and auditability).
2) Procurement: yes, procurement@brightlinehealth is the right mailbox. I’ll loop in Sam Jenkins (procurement lead) on that thread — Sam, can you confirm what standard docs you need (SOW, security addendum, vendor questionnaire)?
3) Timeline: the steering group prefers Wed 6/17 at 09:00 PST. If you can keep the presentation focused (pilot goals, data controls, timeline + ask), that’ll be ideal.

I’ll schedule the 45-minute slot and share calendar invites once I hear back on availability from Marcus and Dr. Park.

Claire Morris
VP Clinical Strategy | Brightline Health
claire.morris@brightlinehealth.com

Connor / Claire —

We’ll need the following to move procurement reviews forward: 
- Draft SOW (scope, timelines, deliverables)
- Security addendum or SOC2 report (if available)
- Standard vendor questionnaire (we’ll send our template)
- Preliminary commercial terms or indicative pricing

Please send the SOW and SOC2 evidence to procurement@brightlinehealth.com and cc me. Also flag any data residency or encryption requirements up front. We typically start legal review after the steering signoff.
